Economics.comment: CAPEX coefficients are in EUR, EUR/t/h or EUR/t/h/km, opex_variable in EUR/t total output, opex_fixed in % of up-front CAPEX. size_min/size_max = 478.8-1692.0 t/h = 133.0-470.0 kg/s, the 'large' evaluation range (see southern_europe/analysis/pipeline_size_class_ranges.py, and pipeline_capex_per_arc_calculator.py::SIZE_CLASS_MASSFLOW_RANGES_KG_S['large'] = (133.0, 470.0) kg/s). gamma1-4 here are a placeholder fallback only - capex_defined_per_arc=1 means the real per-arc values come from gamma_defined_per_arc_pipeline_large.xlsx -> CO2_Pipeline_large/gamma{1..4}.csv. opex_fixed and Performance.energyconsumption.electricity.k_flow, unlike CAPEX, have no per-arc option in AdOpT-NET0 (network.py::para_opex_fixed / _define_energyconsumption_parameters are single scalars per technology) - both are the capex-/flow-weighted mean across this class's built arcs in the reference run, computed by pipeline_size_class_ranges.py (which also writes them here).
